children: HCM III Acquisition's earnings rose year over year, as higher interest earned on Trust Account marketable securities more than offset general and administrative costs. The prior-year quarter included advisory fee reimbursable income and interest, offset by advisory fee expense and operating costs.
: Interest earned on marketable securities was $2.5M, compared with $1.7M a year earlier.
: General and administrative costs increased to $182,253 from $135,337.
: The company had not selected a target and reported no substantive discussions with a prospective target.
: Cash and cash equivalents were $470,727 at September 30, 2026; the company cited substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern.
